risk_note: DSX-50 visual baselines for H5 seven pages (light / dark, 375x844) and admin four pages (light, 1440x900) (规划/05 §3.11.3, D10-724 ③). Comparison against committed baselines only writes test/.tmp/visual-baseline reports (diff over 1% flagged, never failing); a missing baseline fails; a mutation self-check compares with an unmutated reference shot from the same run within the mutated element's box. Implementation is the 18 baseline PNGs only: generated by CI verify-int-1 (artifact visual-baseline-report of spec commit 3c74dc91) because the local container cannot export screenshots; copied unchanged by the orchestrator, every image reviewed as test-fixture pages only (masked phones, fake order numbers), no apps/** change. Rule tests by an independent Claude in five rounds (r3 TS2345 type narrowing, r4 motion regex no longer treats the static dashboard-enter class as motion, r5 baseline / report paths fixed relative to the test/ project root and only a missing file counts as missing — the first land showed the browser resolved the baseline directory one level too high). Host browser run with the baselines: 23/23 green. Non-funds; RV2 only because test/** defaults to RV2. Written by hand.

reviews.note: round 1 pass, no findings (baseline images only; RV2 because test/** defaults to RV2); independent Claude (approvals #36)

spec_test_review.note: fresh Claude subagents: round 1 fail (S1 mutation check compared with committed baseline, S2 diluted mutation area), round 2 pass, incremental review of test rounds 3-4 pass (S2 motion regex short window, followup), incremental review of round 5 (path fix) pass with no findings; tests written by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh)
